text: If your team publishes release notes, look at what it costs to say that a release deserves none. Ask who decides that a change is worth an article, and whether that choice is written down. Ask what happens to a published page when the product feature it describes changes. Before you let a tool draft articles from your release history, check which side of that order it sits on. Ask whether the check that guards your public pages also runs on changes that skip review.
